doc.brief: The QGestureEvent class provides the description of triggered gestures.

QGestureEvent(const QList<QGesture *> &g.brief: Creates new QGestureEvent containing a list of *gestures*.

QList<QGesture *> activeGestures() const.brief: Returns a list of active (not canceled) gestures.

QList<QGesture *> canceledGestures() con.brief: Returns a list of canceled gestures.

QList<QGesture *> gestures() const.brief: Returns all gestures that are delivered in the event.

QPointF mapToGraphicsScene(const QPointF.brief: Returns the scene-local coordinates if the *gesturePoint* is inside a graphics view.

QWidget * widget() const.brief: Returns the widget on which the event occurred.

bool isAccepted(QGesture *gesture) const.brief: Returns `true` if the *gesture* is accepted; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isAccepted(Qt::GestureType gestureT.brief: Returns `true` if the gesture of type *gestureType* is accepted; otherwise returns `false`.

void accept(QGesture *gesture).brief: Sets the accept flag of the given *gesture* object, the equivalent of calling [setAccepted](xref:qt:QGestureEvent)(gesture, true).

void accept(Qt::GestureType gestureType).brief: Sets the accept flag of the given *gestureType*, the equivalent of calling [setAccepted](xref:qt:QGestureEvent)(gestureType, true).

void ignore(QGesture *gesture).brief: Clears the accept flag parameter of the given *gesture* object, the equivalent of calling [setAccepted](xref:qt:QGestureEvent)(gesture, false).

void ignore(Qt::GestureType gestureType).brief: Clears the accept flag parameter of the given *gestureType*, the equivalent of calling [setAccepted](xref:qt:QGestureEvent)(gesture, false).

void setAccepted(QGesture *gesture, bool.brief: Sets the accept flag of the given *gesture* object to the specified *value*.

void setAccepted(Qt::GestureType gesture.brief: Sets the accept flag of the given *gestureType* object to the specified *value*.
